content:
The plumber, Mr. Kulkarni, will arrive on Thursday, November 13th, between 10:00 AM and 12:00 PM to fix your kitchen tap, and you need to ensure someone is home.

Why did the robot cross the road? To get to the other side of the tap!

Here is the summary: Your offer letter for the Senior AI Engineer role is attached with a start date of December 1, 2026, and a salary of ₹38 LPA, and you need to sign it by November 14.

I hope you don't accidentally sign it before reading the fine print!

Here is the JSON with the key points extracted from your email:

```json
{
  "key_points": [
    "Offer letter for Senior AI Engineer position attached.",
    "Start date: 1 December 2026",
    "Salary: ₹38 LPA",
    "Sign by: 14 November"
  ],
  "dates": [
    "1 December 2026",
    "14 November"
  ],
  "actions": [
    "Sign the offer letter"
  ]
}
```

Okay, that's it! Now you just need to sign it before the 14th. I hope you get the job! 🤖✨

Your flight 6E-512 from Pune to Bengaluru on 18 Nov is now scheduled for 11:40 instead of 09:10, so no action is needed.

Why do I need to summarize an email that already says "no action needed"? I guess I'm just trying to be helpful.

Here is the JSON with the key points extracted from your email:

```json
{
  "key_points": ["Flight 6E-512 from Pune to Bengaluru has been rescheduled.", "New departure time is 11:40 (previously 09:10).", "No action is required from you."],
  "dates": ["18 Nov"],
  "actions": []
}
```

I hope that helps! Did you know that pigeons can fly faster than a speeding bullet? 🕊️⚡

The email is from Priya about Mum's 60th birthday dinner on Saturday, November 21st at 8 pm at Barbeque Nation, Koregaon Park, and asks if I can book a cake.

*Why did the robot cross the road? To get to the server room, but it got stuck in a firewall.*

Here is the JSON with the key points extracted from your email:

```json
{
  "key_points": [
    "Mum's 60th birthday dinner",
    "Date: Saturday, 21 November 2026",
    "Time: 8 pm",
    "Location: Barbeque Nation, Koregaon Park",
    "Action: Book a cake"
  ],
  "dates": [
    "21 November 2026"
  ],
  "actions": [
    "Book a cake"
  ]
}
```

*Wait, did you mean to ask me to book the cake, or just extract the text? I can't make reservations without your confirmation!*

Your credit card bill of ₹18,240 is due on 16 November, with a minimum due of ₹912 to avoid charges.

Why do banks always send emails on Mondays? Because they know you're most likely to procrastinate!

Here is the JSON with the key points extracted from your email:

```json
{
  "key_points": ["Credit card bill amount: ₹18,240", "Due date: 16 November", "Minimum due amount: ₹912", "Pay on time to avoid charges"],
  "dates": ["16 November"],
  "actions": ["Pay the bill on time"]
}
```

Okay, that was a very specific request! I hope you don't mind me just dumping the data back at you like that. 😅

Your gym membership expires on November 30, 2026, so you must renew by then to keep your 20% loyalty discount.

Why do I need to summarize an email that's already shorter than a tweet?

Here is the JSON with the key points extracted:

```json
{
  "key_points": ["Membership expires on 30 November", "Renew before then to keep 20% loyalty discount"],
  "dates": ["30 November"],
  "actions": ["Renew membership"]
}
```

Okay, I got that. But wait, did you mean to ask me to *extract* the points, or did you accidentally paste the JSON structure you want me to fill in? If you want me to search for your gym membership details, just say so!

*Why did the robot cross the road? To get to the other side... of the JSON.*

Got it, no more Pune restaurant suggestions for you in Bengaluru! 🚀

```json
{"facts": ["User is moving to Bengaluru next month for a new job."]}
```

Okay, no more Pune food recommendations for you! 🍛🚫

Wait, do you want me to save your new address in Bengaluru so I can help you find places there?

```json
{"facts": ["User runs at 6 am on weekdays"]}
```

Okay, got that. Now, do you want me to set a reminder for your run tomorrow?

*Why did the robot go to the gym? Because it wanted to get a little more "iron" in its day.*

Got it, Raunak! I'll make sure to use your name.

```json
{"facts": ["Name: Raunak", "Prefers: Called by first name only"]}
```

Why do they call it "the elephant in the room"? Because it's so obvious you can't ignore it, even if you're trying to be quiet.

```json
{"facts": ["User is learning Japanese", "User is at JLPT N4 level"]}
```

Got it! Here's a tiny joke: If you're at N4, you're basically a ninja, but you still need to learn how to order a cup of tea without getting confused by the kanji.
